title: Protein Extraction, Mass Spectrometry, and Data Analysis
author: Sierra Palumbos
materials: Randomize and analyze samples on an Exploris 480 mass spectrometer (Thermofisher Scientific San Jose, CA) coupled with an Ultimate 3000 nano UPLC system and an EasySpray source.
Solubilize EV pellets in 50 µL of extraction buffer containing 5% sodium dodecyl sulfate (SDS, Affymetrix), 50mM TEAB (pH 8.5, Sigma), and protease inhibitor cocktail (Roche cOmplete, EDTA free).
Shear DNA and ensure complete solubilization
Proteins were reduced in 5mM TCEP (Thermo), alkylated in 20mM iodoacetamide (Sigma), then acidified with phosphoric acid (Aldrich) to a final concentration of 1.2%

steps.title: Clarify Lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge samples at 3000g for 10 minutes to clarify lysate.

steps.title: Determine Protein Concentration
steps.instruction: Determine protein concentration using intrinsic tryptophan fluorescence on a Synergy H1 microplate reader (BioTek).

substeps.instruction: Excite at 280nm
Read at 350nm
Measure against an in-house generated E.Coli lysate standard curve

steps.title: Sonicate Samples
steps.instruction: Sonicate samples for 10 minutes at 20°C in a Covaris R230 focused-ultrasonicator.

substeps.instruction: Set Dithering: Y=3.0
Set Speed=20.0
Set PIP: 360.0
Set DF: 30
Set CPB: 200

steps.title: Digest Samples via S-Trap Micro
steps.instruction: Digest 10 µg of each sample following the S-Trap Micro (Protifi) manufacturer’s protocol.

substeps.instruction: Dilute samples with 90% methanol (Fisher) in 100 mM TEAB
Load diluted samples onto an S-trap column
Wash three times with 90% methanol in 100 mM TEAB
Add Trypsin (Promega) and LysC (Wako) suspended in 20 µL 50mM TEAB at a 1:10 enzyme:protein ratio
Digest for 18 hours at 37°C in a humidity chamber

steps.title: Elute Peptides
steps.instruction: Elute peptides from the S-Trap column using three sequential washes.

substeps.instruction: Elute with 40 µL of 50 mM TEAB
Elute with 40 µL of 0.1% trifluoroacetic acid (TFA) (Pierce) in water
Elute with 40 µL of 50/50 acetonitrile:water (Fisher) in 0.1% TFA

steps.title: Desalt Samples
steps.instruction: Desalt samples using an Oasis HLB µElution plate (30 µm, Waters).

substeps.instruction: Condition wells two times with 200 µL of acetonitrile
Equilibrate wells three times with 200 µL of 0.1% TFA
Apply samples
Wash three times with 200 µL 0.1% TFA
Elute directly into autosampler vials in three increments of 65 µL of 50:50 acetonitrile:water

steps.title: Reconstitute and Quantify Peptides
steps.instruction: Prepare peptides for injection and determine concentration.

substeps.instruction: Combine eluates and organic solvent
Dry via vacuum centrifugation
Reconstitute in 0.1% TFA containing iRT peptides (Biognosys, Schlieren, Switzerland)
Determine peptide concentration at OD280 using a Synergy H1 microplate reader (BioTek)
Adjust samples to 400 ng/µL for injection
Load 5 µL of sample onto an Acclaim PepMap 100 75 µm x 2 cm trap column (Thermo) at 5 µL/min
Separate on a nanocapillary column (75 µm id × 50 cm 2 µm PepMap RSLC C18 column, Thermo)
Use Mobile phase A (0.1% formic acid) and Mobile phase B (0.1% formic acid/acetonitrile)
Elute peptides into the mass spectrometer at 300 nL/min using a 105-minute gradient from 3% B to 45% B

steps.title: Acquire Mass Spectrometry Data
steps.instruction: Collect data using Data Independent Acquisition (DIA) and Data Dependent Acquisition (DDA) for QC.

substeps.instruction: Set DIA MS scan: 120,000 resolution, 350-1200 m/z range, normalized AGC target 300%, automatic max inject time
Set DIA MS2 scans: 30,000 resolution, normalized AGC target 1000%, automatic injection time, default charge state 3, first mass fixed at 250 m/z, normalized collision energy 27
Inject standard E. coli protein digest between samples in DDA mode for quality control
Analyze spiked-in iRT peptides using QuiC software (Biognosys, Schlieren, Switzerland)
Analyze DDA data in MaxQuant and visualize via PTXQC package

steps.title: Process DIA Raw Files
steps.instruction: Process raw files and identify proteins using Spectronaut 18.7 in direct DIA mode.

substeps.instruction: Use a mouse (mus musculus, 25,508 entries) Uniprot database (canonical and reviewed isoforms), supplemented with 245 common contaminants and iRT peptides
Set enzyme specificity to trypsin with allowance for two potential missed cleavages
Set fixed modification as carbamidomethyl of cysteine
Set variable modifications as protein N-terminal acetylation and oxidation of methionine
Apply a 1% false discovery rate (FDR) limit for precursors, peptides, and proteins

steps.title: Perform Statistical Analysis
steps.instruction: Conduct proteomics data processing and statistical analysis in R.

substeps.instruction: Perform log2 transformation and normalize by subtracting the median value for each sample
Utilize MS2 intensity values from Spectronaut for proteome analysis
Filter to retain only proteins with complete values in at least one cohort
Employ a Limma t-test to identify proteins with differential abundance
Visualize differences through volcano plots
Generate lists of differentially abundant proteins based on adjusted P.Value < 0.05
